concepts.name: Note
concepts.description: A short throwaway test note with a title (1-200 characters) and body text (1-2000 characters), both trimmed and required. Any signed-in user can create, list (newest first by creation time), edit, and delete any note; there is no per-user ownership. Created and last-updated timestamps are recorded by the database. Not for real business, patient, or customer data.
